continuity_reduction_status: CONDITIONAL_ON_CONSERVED_NUCLEAR_VECTOR_CURRENT; point-nucleus identity is an algebraic convention check, not proof of many-body current conservation
omitted_tensor_components: mixed longitudinal/transverse components excluded by the unpolarized parity-even target-tensor symmetry
transverse antisymmetric/helicity-odd combination not used by the leading AFH SigmaPrime-Delta coefficient
approximation: leading-static one-body vector-current candidate with M, Phi'', M-Phi'', Delta, Sigma', and Sigma'-Delta; P3 tensor validation pending
scope: seven-isotope natural-xenon leading-static vector-current candidate; not promoted to a complete full-current prediction until P3 passes

AFH_input_validation.scope: pointwise Python versus native AFH v6.0 ResponseNuclear comparison

formal_width_prescription: Asymmetric Pole prescription: first p-k chi2 propagator zero-width (+i0+); second p'+k chi2 propagator uses constant Gamma_chi2(m_chi2).
nuclear_spatial_momentum: Q_A^2=2*mA*ER+ER^2; used only in AFH y_A and spatial NR coefficients
nucleon_transfer_scheme: one-body impulse-current external-transfer assignment q_N^mu=q_A^mu; t_N=t_A=-2*m_A*E_R
transfer_vector_storage: Each isotope row stores qA_four_vector_GeV and qN_four_vector_GeV in the q-aligned (+z) frame, together with tA_GeV2 and tN_GeV2; metric signature is +---.
primary_baseline: B: finite-t_N effective nucleon current times finite-size AFH W_M(y_A) only
A_reference: q=0 effective nucleon current times the same finite-size AFH W_M(y_A)
C_extension: B plus Phi'' and signed M-Phi'' interference; diagnostic extension, not the primary baseline
response_interpolation: common linear interpolation on native AFH response matrices to preserve PSD/Cauchy bounds; PCHIP retained as a diagnostic
recoil_momentum: q_A=sqrt(2 m_A E_R + E_R^2), exact nuclear mass-shell relation
coulomb_weight: L_C=L00-(E_R/q_A)(L03+L30)+(E_R/q_A)^2 L33, conditional on conservation of the complete nuclear vector current
transverse_weight: L_T=L11+L22 for the leading-static AFH Delta/SigmaPrime/SigmaPrimeDelta coefficients
